newsitem.title: UK: Pathfinder Properties sets debut premium.
newsitem.headline: Pathfinder Properties sets debut premium.

text.p: Shares in property developer Pathfinder Properties Plc set a premium on their first day of trade on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on Tuesday.
By 0910 GMT the shares were quoted at 17-1/2p, slightly ahead of their 17p issue price, although no trade was registered in the stock. At the issue price the company was valued at 1.8 million stg.
Pathfinder, which said it raised no new money with the issue, was set up under the Business Expansion Scheme (BES), a company spokesman said.
The broker to the issue was Teather and Greenwood and the nominated advisor was Johnson Fry Securities Ltd.
